summary: Comprehensive testing of SB Pay application completed. Backend APIs: 30/30 tests passed (100%). Frontend UI: All admin and user flows working correctly. All payment integrations (Stripe, PayPal, Mobile Money) are in DEMO/simulated mode as expected.

backend: Admin stats requires admin role (403 for users)
Admin get documents by status filter
frontend: Landing page loads with SB Pay branding
Admin login and redirect to admin dashboard
Admin dashboard stats display (4 stat cards)
Admin Users page navigation and search
Admin Zones page with zone list
User login and redirect to dashboard
User dashboard wallets display (EUR, USD, XOF)
Deposit page with 3 payment tabs (Card, PayPal, Mobile Money)
Mobile Money providers display (Orange, MTN, Wave, Moov)

critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py is a monolithic file (~1900 lines) - consider splitting into modules for maintainability
All payment integrations (Stripe, PayPal, Mobile Money, Twilio SMS) are correctly in DEMO mode as specified
context_for_next_testing_agent: All core features tested and working. Backend has 30 comprehensive API tests. Frontend tested with Playwright for admin and user flows. Payment integrations are MOCKED/DEMO mode. Transfer form correctly disables when user has insufficient balance (0 EUR).

list: Stripe payments - Demo mode, checkout URL generated but not real
PayPal payments - Demo mode with auto-capture simulation
Mobile Money (Orange, MTN, Wave, Moov) - Demo mode with auto-confirm
Twilio SMS for 2FA - Demo mode, logs to database instead of sending
Exchange rates - Static rates defined in code
